name: Fine Feasts
line_of_business: Premium casual dining and executive catering for Tier 4 and Tier 5 clientele
description:
Fine Feasts is Libation Corporation's upmarket dining brand, occupying the Tier 4–5 segment of the GLMZ food service market. Locations are found in corporate arcologies, executive districts, and major transit hubs serving professional-class commuters. Entry requires a Tier 4 or higher Citizen ID; Tier 5 guests receive expedited seating and access to a reservation tier simply called 'Private.'

The ambiance is carefully calibrated: real textile napkins (though synthetic in composition), printed menus rather than wall-projected displays, and servers who have completed a one-week courtesy training program. The food itself is the same industrial substrate that feeds the rest of the Libation portfolio, but at Fine Feasts it arrives plated with garnish elements that are genuinely fresh — small-batch vertical-grown microgreens, a portion of actual animal-derived protein approximately 60 grams per entree, and sauces that involve non-reconstituted ingredients. These real elements cost Libation Corp approximately Φ 0.40 per plate to include. The markup they justify is Φ 48 to Φ 180 per cover.

Fine Feasts is where Tier 4 professionals take clients to signal that the meeting matters. Corporate expense accounts are the primary payment mechanism. The chain's loyalty program, the Fine Feasts Member Circle, provides status tracking that integrates directly with Citizen ID tier data — a Tier 4 member who attends 40 or more Fine Feasts meals annually receives a notation on their ID profile that several employers use as a soft positive signal in hiring decisions. The corporation is aware that this creates a feedback loop. It considers this a feature.
known_products: The Private Reserve (Tier 5 dining room access)
Fine Feasts Member Circle loyalty program
